release.body:
ArgDigest 0.14.0 makes scientific dependencies optional and improves decorated method validation.

Changes:

- Basic installation and standard pipelines work without NumPy. Scientific consumers should declare NumPy or use `argdigest[science]`; `argdigest[pyunitwizard]` includes NumPy and PyUnitWizard.
- Only literal boolean `skip_digestion=True` bypasses validation. Truthy strings and integers now follow normal digestion.
- Classmethods work in both decorator orders without digesting the `cls` receiver.
- Digesters can accept optional `qualname` for the runtime class-qualified method; existing `caller` registry keys are preserved.
- Contract refusals show their cause and allowed arguments more clearly.
- PyUnitWizard adapter and factory creation defer provider imports until execution while preserving missing-provider diagnostics and original transitive import errors.

Migration: replace truthy bypass flags with explicit booleans and declare scientific dependencies explicitly. Python 3.11–3.14 and core floors (DepDigest 0.11.0, SMonitor 0.16.0) remain unchanged.

This release uses staging and exact-file promotion. Its source, full installed suite and NumPy-free core are verified separately; publication receipts identify the exact candidate and package digest. Zenodo archival is independently checked and covers only the source snapshot. Conda promotion and documentation deployment run separately after GitHub publication.

Release coordination: https://github.com/uibcdf/argdigest/issues/24. Consumer notice: https://github.com/uibcdf/molsyssuite/issues/98.

Qualified artifact: `argdigest-0.14.0-py_0.tar.bz2` (noarch, build 0), source `0fa776af2d271065c60727c28480b20c3ce09aee`, SHA-256 `983dca0f6bd0944d81fb1efc01e1dfa5c951e95abac6e7a0a08a13b7370d3b9e`.

- [Producer](https://github.com/uibcdf/argdigest/actions/runs/37210475369).
- [Source suite: 12 cells](https://github.com/uibcdf/argdigest/actions/runs/37210325527).
- [Full installed suite: 12 cells](https://github.com/uibcdf/argdigest/actions/runs/37213239915), with scientific imports outside the checkout and final provenance checks.
- [Minimal core: 12 cells](https://github.com/uibcdf/argdigest/actions/runs/37211211381), without NumPy and with public lower-bound dependency builds.
